attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT i.imported_file_id
FROM code.imports AS i
WHERE i.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/__init__.py'
  AND i.imported_file_id IS NOT NULL
  AND i.imported_file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%'
ORDER BY i.imported_file_id
